ask_text: voice-lint: scope the voice obligation to the turn that produced the record
veto_reason: SecOps VETO on Phase 2 review: the proposed human-turn freshness predicate (R5) classifies voice-lint's own blocking refusal record as a human turn, so the Stop-hook control disarms itself the moment it first fires -- a resent identical message then passes (rc 0). This is the SECOND consecutive Phase 2 round to return REQUEST_CHANGES, which trips the round-budget rule in commands/pipeline.md's Convergence budget section: do not auto-loop a third BA rework; stop and let the owner choose split / defer / proceed-with-constraints.

Round 3 will re-dispatch only dba and secops; devops is not re-seated (its round-2 APPROVE_WITH_NOTES is preserved unchanged, since neither targeted fix touches its lens).
